Arsenal's Calafiori Scores Record-Breaking Fastest Community Shield Goal

Riccardo Calafiori scored for Arsenal after just 23 seconds against Manchester City in the 2026 Community Shield. This strike set a new record as the fastest goal in the competition's 118-year history, surpassing Gary McAllister's previous record. Arsenal went on to double their lead.
